question: Introducing a girl, a boy said, "She is the only daughter of the only child of my paternal grandmother." How is the girl related to the boy?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf9WrMX2PxUUiuc23xtLzIYfAm-irKB4b57QlaLQLGdZfRiZezLGmE-LDNzE8Cwo2irGS7CWeUw-nY5zMYIdWPZre6UsWnYjv1MpUAVRhIwEu2rYK0rb8Zv1_QSlVCu5fvDClEGTgVIIgUmbHNzoyQcd8-5?key=Pg8w9VmbvKrHmQxFZbtW-g] 

The boy says, "She is the only daughter of the only child of my paternal grandmother."

**Now,**

1) "Paternal Grandmother" - This refers to the mother of the boy's father.

2) "Only child of my paternal grandmother" - The only child of a person's paternal grandmother is their **Father**.

3) "Only daughter of the only child" - This translates to the **"Only daughter of my father"**.

4) Final Relationship - The only daughter of the boy's father is the boy's **Sister**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cd230ff5b39a8cc64da441c5485005492236cb5c466ec1b181c11c51308ed0e.png] 

Therefore, the girl is the **Sister** of the boy.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
